metadata.bug: The asynchronous reset sensitivity uses the falling edge of reset instead of its rising edge.
metadata.trigger: Reset is asserted while clk is low and remains asserted until at least one clock edge; the assertion itself does not trigger the block.
metadata.effect: cnt_q is not asynchronously loaded on reset assertion; it loads only on a later clock edge while reset is high.

reason: Async reset \reset yields non-constant value 5'mmmmm for signal \cnt_q.
supplemental_reason: Async reset \reset yields non-constant value 5'mmmmm for signal \cnt_q.
